user_prompt: Our engineering team keeps pushing through design changes that require updates to our IT infrastructure, but we're struggling to keep pace with manual coordination across multiple systems. Right now, when a new component specification comes through, we have to manually track which servers need reconfiguration, which licenses need reallocation, and which hardware needs to be deployed—and it's creating delays and tracking errors. We need a way to automate this entire workflow so that when engineering changes are approved, all the downstream IT infrastructure changes happen consistently and in the right sequence.

result_preview.description: Monitors engineering change requests and automatically processes material requisitions and product item allocations. Coordinates asset provisioning workflows by orchestrating material movements, tracking product item assignments to change orders, and automating fulfillment notifications. Processes provisioning requests in real-time to ensure timely asset availability for organizational change initiatives.

result_preview.description: Monitors engineering change requests and coordinates their execution across material inventories and product item configurations. Automates provisioning workflows by processing change approvals and synchronizing updates to related materials and product items. Orchestrates multi-step change operations to ensure consistent delivery across the ITSM ecosystem.

result_preview.description: Exposes endpoints to retrieve and manage IT equipment provisioning workflows, integrating service ticket requirements with change request approvals. Provides access to asset allocation, vendor assignments, and provisioning status updates across the ITSM ecosystem.
